chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:

Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has regions called al-Muntaqimah. When Allah grants a servant wealth and he does not give Allah’s rightful due from it, Allah subjects him to a spot from those regions, and that wealth is destroyed there; then he dies and leaves it behind.

key_terms.بِقَاعًا تُسَمَّى الْمُنْتَقِمَةَ: regions described as places of divine retribution
key_terms.حَقَّ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: the due that Allah has made obligatory in one's wealth
key_terms.سَلَّطَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ: Allah causes something to overpower or afflict him
key_terms.فَأَتْلَفَ ذَلِكَ الْمَالَ: the destruction and wasting of that wealth
key_terms.مَالًا: wealth or property granted to a servant

ai.seo_question: What happens if a person does not give the right of Allah from his wealth?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that wealth from which the right of Allah is withheld becomes a cause of loss and ruin. The hadith warns that failing to discharge the divinely due share in one’s property leads to worldly destruction of wealth, after which the person dies leaving it behind.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5908 - Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Indeed, Allah (swt), the Blessed and Exalted, has lands called Al-Muntaqimah (The Avenger). When Allah (swt) grants a servant wealth and he does not give Allah's (swt) rightful due from it, Allah (swt) assigns to him a portion of those lands where his wealth is wasted, and then he dies, leaving it behind."
